Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 8:29pm

Ronaldo Mulitalo had basically the entire Roosters team off side by the end of the game. (Supplied: Kayo Sports)

The Roosters finish with a wet sail to beat the Sharks 27-8 as Mark Nawaqanitawase gets a double in a heated but one-sided battle with opposite number Ronaldo Mulitalo.

Earlier, Will Warbrick scored three tries in a phenomenal outing to help Melbourne to a 42-20 win over the Raiders in Cameron Munster's 250th NRL match.

In the first game of the day, Charnze Nicoll-Klokstad scored four against the Cowboys as the Warriors dominated in the first game at a new stadium in Christchurch.

Look back at all the action in our live blog below and check out all the stats in the full ScoreCentre.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 8:20pm

By Jon Healy

Another round of footy in the dust, but I cannot tell you how much sport there is around at the moment.

Make sure you're all over ABC Sport as the carnival continues.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 8:14pm

By Jon Healy

Some interesting stories in there, including the Roosters jumping up into the top four tonight.

The Melbourne Storm are also an interesting case with today's 42-20 win over the Raiders leaving them 11th, but with seven wins (the same number as the seventh-placed Rabbitohs) with two more byes still to come. They've won five of their past six since losing seven in a row. Could they do a Penrith?

Next week will be an almighty test against Manly, a team that has enjoyed a similarly remarkable turnaround.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 8:05pm

By Jon Healy

At the end of it all, it's all love and respect between Ronaldo Mulitalo and Mark Nawaqanitawase but the Roosters and Marky Mark are runaway winners in tonight's game.

It was a pretty dominant performance by the Roosters.

Even when the score was tight, it felt like they were right on top and it came to a head in the second half with some excellent execution.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 8:01pm

By Jon Healy

The Roosters spin it right and Ronaldo Mulitalo jams in to lay a shot on Rob Toia as he passes, standing over the Roosters centre, all the while Mark Nawaqanitawase puts a move on KL Iro to score a brilliant try.

In the celebrations, Toia and Lindsay Collins, who had a few words to say after a Mulitalo error, single out Ronaldo for a chat and the rest of the team joins in.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:58pm

By Jon Healy

The Sharks winger scoops up a bouncing Braydon Trindall pass, tries an in-and-away on Mark Nawaqanitawase, and it just about works, but James Tedesco comes in to help finish the job.

And doesn't he let him know all about it.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:52pm

By Jon Healy

A third field goal for the weekend as Daly Cherry-Evans takes the first opportunity to make it 21-8 with a clean snap from 20 metres out.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:50pm

By Jon Healy

The Sharks are throwing everything at them, but the Roosters' defence is good enough to hang on, with big Lindsay Collins breaking up a cross-field kick with a big bat back with his big left mitt.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:44pm

By Jon Healy

The Roosters have been kicking across field to Mark Nawaqanitawase all night and Ronaldo Mulitalo has been doing a pretty good job to disrupt him, but finally the former Wallaby gets up above, takes the clean grab and manages to ground it. And Marky Mark lets him know about it when he gets up. They've been going at it all night.

Coincidentally, the try came after the Roosters won a captain's challenge for an illegal contest by Mulitalo on Nawaqanitawase off a short dropout.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:35pm

By Jon Healy

He leaps for a kick against Sione Katoa and drives his face straight into the forearm of Katoa. He knocks in the process and is left sprawled on the turf.

He gets up and argues with referee Ashley Klein, who requests Tedesco clean himself up before talking to him.

I'm not sure what Tedesco is arguing by the way. Katoa did nothing wrong and Tedesco clearly knocked on.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:27pm

By Jon Healy

Sam Walker's penalty goal from dead in front makes it 16-8 to the Roosters with half an hour left.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:26pm

By Jon Healy

Briton Nikora is lucky to get away with a forward pass to Jesse Ramien, who then throws a ridiculous offload that ends up in a turnover.

And then Sam Walker plays out of dummy half and gets pushed by Nicho Hynes as he passes, and Hynes is penalised for not marking up. Harsh call for mine.

Will Kennedy is penalised for hands in the ruck, so Sam Walker will kick for goal.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:20pm

By Jon Healy

Cronulla gets a repeat set as DCE picks up a dropped ball in an offside position and Nicho Hynes throws a gorgeous left-to-right ball past two teammates and onto the chest of Sione Katoa to score. That might be the best pass I've ever seen Hynes throw.

Also, Hynes has changed numbers from 22 to 23. He was covered in blood and mud just before the break, so he's switch tops.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:16pm

By Jon Healy

The Roosters kick off and Tom Hazelton runs it back for Cronulla.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:02pm

By Jon Healy

It looks like Ronaldo Mulitalo is heading off for an HIA as the siren sounds.

But the play has been made and 14-4 looks and feels very different to 14-0 at half-time in this one.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 7:01pm

By Jon Healy

The ball goes left to Ronaldo Mulitalo to score a great try diving into the corner.

James Tedesco flies across in cover and takes an awkward tumble, and it looks like he's accidentally had a head clash or hit Mulitalo with an elbow.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 6:57pm

By Jon Healy

We love a trick play here at ABC Sport and this time it's an NFL-style onside kick, scuffed low and out to the right, perfectly on the bounce to Nicho Hynes.

The Sharks can't do anything with it, but you still love to see it.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 6:53pm

By Jon Healy

The Sharks just can't wrap up the Roosters' big bodies and it's costing them. This time Mark Nawaqanitawase swoops on a loose ball out the back and surprises them with a late offload to Connor Watson, who scoots through the line and finds Sam Walker. The halfback could get low and score, but instead he passes to Billy Smith for a try and what should be an easier conversion for Walker.

The Roosters lead the offload count 13-4 and lead the game 14-0 as Walker converts the try.

Key Event

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 6:45pm

By Jon Healy

The high kick goes across towards the Nawaqanitawase-Mulitalo battle.

Mulitalo manages to get hands to hit and bat it backwards, but it bounce up past Braydon Trindall and into the hands of Rob Toia.

Did Nawaqanitawase get a hand to it in the air? Perhaps, but I don't think any of the angles will be able to prove that conclusively.

Sun 21 Jun 2026 at 6:44pm

By Jon Healy

The Roosters spin it right and Mark Nawaqanitawase catches on his knees before regaining his footing and getting rocked by KL Iro and Ronaldo Mulitalo.

Mulitalo is penalised for some work on the face of Nawawqanitawase, but that was really soft.
